summary: Tioga County tree tower dated 1916 and used until about 1917; the register says it is no longer standing and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: tree tower (register); tree observation post at 40 feet above the ground (forest-lookout history)
facts.status_note: Register says no longer standing; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site today

events.note: Register: tree tower built in 1916. Forest-lookout history: 1916 tree observation post at 40 feet above the ground
Registered September 16, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: tree tower built in 1916, used until circa 1917, no longer standing
evidence.quote: This tree tower was built in 1916, used until circa 1917 and is no longer standing.

evidence.supports: 1916 tree observation post set at 40 feet above the ground
evidence.quote: 1916: A tree observation post established at 40 feet above the ground.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register calls the 1916 structure a tree tower; the forest-lookout history calls it a tree observation post. Both date it to 1916, so they may be one structure. The story says so only conditionally, since neither source says so outright.

notes_for_editor: Brief coordinates (41.82488, -77.41562) are not on the register, which says 'No coordinates are available', and I could not check them, so they are not in the story. Brief kind 'unknown' could read 'tree' per the register. The 40-foot figure is converted to 12.2 m as the height of the observation post, not a verified structure height. The history's 1916 entry gives no source of its own. The per-site easternuslookouts page for Broad Ridge returns 404. Two searches and about four page reads found nothing on staffing, fires or current access, so those are left out.
